title: Relative priority of routing rules can change from unrelated rules
author: sdegueldre
body_preview: ## Titular issue  Have two rules with a dynamic segment using different converters with the same weight in your application. When a request comes in that could match both rules, it matches the first because it was registered first, as documented:  > Rules may end up with the same priority, by having static parts with the same length, and dynamic parts with the same weight, in the same positions.
